QuestInfo.name: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #p403# again at #m10003000#. A while ago, she was doing a favor for #p401# and getting some #t4003000#s for him. But the Sack of Cash he gave her to buy them fell out of her pocket while she was walking around in the subway, and she lost it. She said it fell deep into the subway station, to #bConstruction Site B3#k.
QuestInfo.2: I found #p403#'s lost Sack of Cash in the #m10003000# subway. #p403# can now buy what #p401# asked for. I received Mesos and some potions as a gift. I should go to #bConstruction Site B3#k in the subway to look for more stuff.

0.0: Whoa... I've been waiting for you to come back! What? Did I lose money again? Yep... Well, this time, it's a lot... Someone I know asked me for a favor. He wanted me to get him #b100 #t4003000#s#k. He gave me a Sack of Cash to buy them, so I put it in my pocket and was carrying it on me. It was super heavy, though! I accidentally dropped it, and it fell through a hole in the ground. And that's how I lost the money... Can you find it for me?

yes.0: Thank you so much! Well, the person that asked for the favor is sitting waaaaaay down there. His name is #p401#, and he worked hard for that money with his backdoor dealings. If he ever finds out that I lost that money, he'll go crazy on me. Don't be fooled by his appearance; he's got quite a temper... Argh... Pleaaase help me! Please help me find the Sack of Cash! You're the only one I can count on right now!
yes.1: I think I dropped the Sack of Cash deep in the Subway, in #bConstruction Site B3#k. I tried to go there and retrieve it myself, but there are even more weird devices all over the place down there. So I only managed to take a look at it from a distance. This may be difficult, even for you, this time around. Anyway, please, please, please get that Sack of Cash for me. I believe in you...

no.0: You must be busy, huh? But if you ever change your mind, then please help me. I'm being serious here...

1.0: Hey, it's the Sack of Cash I lost! Phew... It's all good now. I knew you'd find it... Seriously, you should become a professional for this... But hey... You didn't take any for yourself, right? Let me see... I'm not doubting your honesty, but I still have to count it... one... two... three... four... Hm, seems okay.
1.1: Thanks! Here's a reward for taking up my request.

yes.0: I raised your EXP and Fame for helping me. I also gave you some Mesos, so spend them well. Oh, and I threw in some good potions too. Thanks again, and I'll let you know if I have any more troubles.

item.0: Still haven't found the sack of money that I lost? Without it, I don't know what he's going to do with me... You may find it at the #bConstruction Site B3 of #m10003000##k subway. Be careful, there is some weird equipment in there. I believe in you.
